question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) in relation to environmental impacts, sustainability, lifecycle information?
description: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) is an analytical methodology used to analyze and quantify the environmental aspects and impacts of product systems, such as materials, products, processes, buildings, over their entire life cycle. LCA is applied in areas like product development and improvement, aiming to understand the environmental implications throughout the product's life cycle. This assessment helps in making informed decisions towards sustainability by evaluating the lifecycle information and environmental impacts associated with the product system.
